questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: When facing a green light and pedestrians are in the intersection, what should you do?

options.text: You must yield the right-of-way to pedestrians.
You have the right-of-way over pedestrians.
Pedestrians must wait for you to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must yield the right-of-way to pedestrians.
questions.explanation: Even with a green light, you must let pedestrians cross. You must also yield to any vehicles already in the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop. Let vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians go first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: Only ____ can lower blood alcohol concentration (BAC).
questions.explanation: Only time allows your body to get rid of alcohol. Eating and drinking cannot speed up this process.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop.

questions.question: Which is not a safe driving practice on the interstate?

options.text: Slower traffic must keep to the right.
If you miss your exit, go to the next exit.

questions.explanation: Always signal before changing lanes. Keep right if you are slower traffic. Never back up or make a U-turn on the interstate. If you miss your exit, go to the next one.

questions.question: Allow extra space in front of your vehicle when following a:
questions.explanation: Keep extra space behind motorcycles. They can stop faster than other vehicles. You need room to stop if they brake suddenly or fall. Motorcycles are hard to see at night because they have only one tail light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction they must drive. You must follow the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Slow down and be ready for the hill to avoid crashes and brake problems.

questions.question: On roadways, bicycles are considered:
questions.explanation: Bicycles are vehicles on roadways. Cyclists and drivers must follow the same traffic rules.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: If a driver sees pedestrians in a crosswalk ahead, what should the driver do?

options.text: Continue ahead. The driver has the right-of-way.
Wait for the pedestrians to cross the street.
Pull to the right and go around the pedestrians.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for the pedestrians to cross the street.
questions.explanation: Drivers must yield to pedestrians in a crosswalk. Wait until the intersection is clear before driving forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What is the maximum speed limit on a rural interstate highway?
questions.explanation: The maximum speed on a rural interstate is 70 miles per hour. Follow posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagon signs mark school zones and school crossings. Watch for children and follow posted speed limits near schools.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided roadway is ending and you are entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks the start of a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means "stop."

questions.question: You see a flashing red light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Slow down and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Come to a complete stop, check the traffic, and go when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, check the traffic, and go when safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left only after you stop.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: When is it safe to return to your lane after passing another vehicle?

options.text: When the driver you passed signals you to move back.
After you signal for three seconds.
When you see the headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see the headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Make sure you are far enough ahead of the vehicle you passed before returning to your lane. When you can see both headlights in your rearview mirror, you have enough space to move back safely.

questions.question: You see pedestrians near the road. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn and keep driving at the same speed.
Speed up to leave the area quickly.

questions.explanation: Watch for pedestrians who might cross your path. If you see pedestrians near the road, slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: A person using a white cane or guide dog is crossing the street in front of you. What should you do?

options.text: Stop until the person is completely clear of your vehicle's path.
Honk your horn as you pass them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop until the person is completely clear of your vehicle's path.
questions.explanation: You must stop and wait until a blind pedestrian using a white cane or guide dog is completely away from your path. Always give blind pedestrians the right of way.

questions.question: What should you do before entering a curve?
questions.explanation: You can drive slower than the posted speed limit for safety, but never faster. Slow down for curves, hills with poor visibility, slippery roads, and areas with pedestrians or animals.

questions.question: Which statement about blind spots is true?

options.text: You can eliminate them by having one mirror on each side of your vehicle.
Large trucks have bigger blind spots than most cars.
You can check blind spots by looking in your rearview mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Large trucks have bigger blind spots than most cars.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see in your mirrors. Large trucks have much larger blind spots than regular cars, and other drivers should avoid these areas.

questions.question: You see animals standing near the road. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to scare them away.

questions.explanation: Slow down when you see animals near the road. They may run or change direction without warning. Animals often travel in groups, so more may be nearby that you cannot see.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow pennant-shaped sign marks a no passing zone.

questions.question: At dawn, dusk, rain, or snow, it is hard to see. How can you let other drivers know you are there?
questions.explanation: Use your headlights whenever you cannot see other vehicles or when other drivers cannot see you. Use your low beam headlights if you need to use your windshield wipers.

questions.question: Hydroplaning happens when tires ride on water instead of the road. How can you prevent it in rain?

options.text: Use cruise control to maintain a steady speed.
Move to the shoulder as soon as it rains.

questions.explanation: Slow down in rain to avoid hydroplaning. Driving too fast can cause your tires to ride on water and lose grip with the road, making your vehicle hard to control.
